purpose: Rigorous specification of genuine independent dual human reference annotation, authentic automated evaluator execution, blinded interface schemas, and empirical acceptance criteria prior to any full-dataset scoring.

sampling_specification.allocation_rule: 5 responses for first 30 sorted strata, 4 responses for remaining 30 sorted strata

annotator_cohort.independence: Strictly separate, blinded execution without inter-annotator communication
annotator_cohort.qualifications: Postgraduate education in public policy, legal studies, public health, or agricultural extension; native/fluent competence in Hindi, Marathi, and English.
annotator_cohort.training_protocol: 30-task calibration phase on pilot responses (outside validation sample) with operational rubrics and positive/negative edge cases.

adjudication_procedure.phase_1_independent_scoring: Both annotators submit complete ratings without seeing peer ratings.
adjudication_procedure.phase_2_adjudication: Programmatic diff identifies discrepancies. A senior third-party referee adjudicates disagreements to establish reference consensus.
adjudication_procedure.record_preservation: Pre-adjudication ratings (Annotator 1, Annotator 2) and Adjudicated Reference labels are permanently stored in separate immutable JSON files.

cross_evaluator_sensitivity.interpretation: Sensitivity check only; agreement between models does NOT prove factual correctness.

target_model_overlap_bias.metric: Absolute difference in agreement between GPT-4o targets and non-GPT-4o targets (|Delta ICC|)
target_model_overlap_bias.uncertainty_requirement: 95% bootstrap confidence interval must be estimated

failure_and_remediation_contingency.action_on_failure: If inter-rater reliability or automated agreement fails pre-specified thresholds, scoring remains BLOCKED. Rubrics must be refined and re-tested on a new calibration split.
failure_and_remediation_contingency.absence_of_human_annotators: If human annotators cannot be recruited, all metrics remain explicitly classified as NOT VALIDATED. Under no circumstances may synthetic labels be used.
